exclusions.reason: Preserved third-party source repositories and their own documentation; not newly authored native-port reports.
User-owned run artifacts, not documentation; leave untouched.
Machine-readable evidence, raw numerical arrays and execution logs remain authoritative source files; interpreted reports link them rather than printing thousands of raw rows.

exclusions.pattern: original user literature/documentation PDFs outside the repository
exclusions.reason: Original source literature, not new native-port documentation; excluded from redistribution.
Application interface, not an authored documentation page.
License notices are retained as source files and discussed in THIRD_PARTY; may be optionally packaged as a separate legal-notices appendix.

layout_flags: Acceptance matrix Markdown is approximately 105 kB, with 81 requirement details plus summary tables; preserve every stable ID and failed status.
Full CSV ledger has 18 columns, options/methods have 9 columns, pilot table has 22 columns; do not squeeze to tiny text.
Methods annex has 585 rows; count includes inherited/public repetitions and is not a unique-function completion denominator.
Options annex has 143 rows: 127 enum choices plus 16 interpolation selections; these counts are not additive with requirement/method counts.
GUI_VERIFICATION is the 0.2.0 checkpoint; GUI_USABILITY_VERIFICATION describes later changes.
VERIFICATION and PROGRESS retain historical tests/failures; keep them intact and identify the most recent checkpoint in the index.
Several Markdown documents contain Unicode math, Greek letters, superscripts, long hashes, code, tables and local relative links; font coverage and wrapping need visual checks.
No other native authored RST/HTML report was found. The only non-Markdown narrative-like outputs are raw exit-code text, intentionally excluded.
